propositions: Cloning this repository over blobless filter (--filter=blob:none) is 15x faster (14.3s vs 59s) and 15x smaller (68.7 MiB vs 1.04 GiB) than full clone; --filter=tree:0 must not be used as it produces 3.57 GiB
derive_caused_by calls _blame_file_commits on every bug close without explicit --caused-by, which faults blobs one at a time under a blobless promisor, risking partial failure
_blame_file_commits returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure and emptiness indistinguishable

When blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, derive_caused_by tallies the partial set and can elect a wrong culprit that would not have won over the full set, writing an incorrect caused_by link
_blame_file_commits must be changed to return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty result, and derive_caused_by must abort on any None per-path result
